recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a male figure in profile, wearing aviator sunglasses and a leather jacket, set against a dense, textured foliage background with bold, geometric typography anchored at the top right and bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark silhouette against mid-tone textured foliage
Reflection in sunglasses mirroring the surrounding environment
Hierarchy between solid display text and outlined secondary text
Balance between the top-right name placement and bottom-center title
coreInvariants: Heavy shadows on the subject's face and jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the chest up in a three-quarter profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, opaque lenses of the sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sunglasses, move down the profile to the bottom text, then sweep up to the top-right name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side is filled with out-of-focus foliage, providing a textured backdrop for the upper text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, jacket, and sunglasses for structural weight.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure whites in the text outlines and highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the background foliage to create depth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text is solid black with a subtle outer glow or light background contrast
Bottom text features a double-layered effect: solid inner fill with a distinct white outline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and treatments (solid vs. outlined).

preserve: Bottom-center alignment for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp vertices.
Provides the necessary geometric structure and tight kerning capability.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man with an afro and aviator sunglasses, wearing a leather jacket, in profile. The background should be a dense, out-of-focus thicket of plants and leaves. Use a grainy, film-noir aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text. Place the artist name in the top right in solid black. Place the title at the bottom center in a larger size, using black fill with a thin white outline, stacked in two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the bottom text outlined in white?
Is the font geometric and uppercase?
Is the subject in profile wearing sunglasses?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
Exact brand logos on sunglasses or jacket
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between text and background.
Ensure the grain does not obscure the letterforms.
Verify the sunglasses have a reflective quality.
Confirm the bottom text is centered and stacked.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif + Outlined Display Text + Textured Organic Background.
